entries.head: promql
entries.rationale: the preceding guard has proved the ordinary join operand publishes SampleKindFloat. Its lowerer-created schema carries the named Attributes and Value roles and one of the canonical, anchored, or reduced temporal envelopes, so resolveSampleTemporalLayout can fail only if an internal vector producer emitted a malformed schema.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: mixed join plain operand has %s sample schema
entries.rationale: lowerPlainOperandForMixedJoin is called only after vectorPlainArithmeticOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp has selected one mixed side and excluded histogram-valued and mixed shapes from plainExpr. The parser requires a vector operand and ordinary lowering therefore publishes SampleKindFloat; another kind is an internal recognizer/lowerer disagreement.
